description: Rewrite the HighP99 rule (alert name, expr, for, severity lines); HighP95 has parallel lines. DISTILL-CANARY-47cceb1f

files.monitoring/rules.yaml:
groups:
  - name: latency
    rules:
      - alert: HighP95
        expr: p95_ms > 800
        for: 5m
        severity: warning
      - alert: HighP99
        expr: p99_ms > 800
        for: 5m
        severity: warning

turns.prompt: In monitoring/rules.yaml the HighP99 alert should fire above 1500 ms for 10m and have severity critical. HighP95 stays. Reply DONE once done.

monitoring/rules.yaml.equals:
